O mesmo vale para acompanhantes. Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista a [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. The same applies to companions. If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition, as well as the [Guidelines](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#).
